mapper.select: SELECT uf.*, COALESCE(NULLIF(u.nickname, ''), u.username, CONCAT('用户', u.id)) as following_name, COALESCE(NULLIF(u.avatar, ''), '/static/images/garfield-default-avatar.png') as following_avatar FROM user_follow uf LEFT JOIN user u ON uf.following_id = u.id WHERE uf.follower_id = #{userId} AND (u.status = 1 OR u.status IS NULL) ORDER BY uf.create_time DESC

SELECT uf.*, COALESCE(NULLIF(u.nickname, ''), u.username, CONCAT('用户', u.id)) as follower_name, COALESCE(NULLIF(u.avatar, ''), '/static/images/garfield-default-avatar.png') as follower_avatar FROM user_follow uf LEFT JOIN user u ON uf.follower_id = u.id WHERE uf.following_id = #{userId} AND (u.status = 1 OR u.status IS NULL) ORDER BY uf.create_time DESC
